purpose: Development diagnostic; not historical holdout, calibration or a promotion experiment
metric: Mean official each-category share against all actual independently completed opponent rosters
pairing: Same league, seat, initial keepers, public projections and player-period outcome tape; opponent picks re-run legally after interventions
independent_unit_for_intervals: Generated league, aggregating its seats before bootstrapping
calibration_split: None; parameters fixed as research defaults before this diagnostic
other_comparisons: B2 and B3 exploratory; no post-hoc winner declares promotion
B0: Unavailable; no archival external rankings invented for synthetic players
B4: Roster-only engine; timing is identically zero
failure_policy: Record every failed draft and omit its entire paired seat block from comparisons; never silently substitute another policy
unsupported_scope: hard position caps in B2 global anchor
revisions_after_outcomes: None permitted for this protocol ID
